The Ranked_expectation uses must occur with an explicit or implicit quantification. The Completeness uses can only occur with entities that have salient necessary parts and structure.

ex.t: The entire apple was riddled with worms .
The inevitable fate of the Warsaw Resistance fighters was not finally sealed until nine whole weeks of vicious fighting had taken a terrible toll on the people .
A mere two percent of Afghan women are registered to vote.

fes.d: The item which is described in terms of its expectedness in the context.

name: Rape
d: The words in this frame describe situations in which the Perpetrator has sexual intercourse with the Victim forcibly (or by threatening the use of force) and without his or her consent.

ex.t: Does the press make it more difficult for raped women to obtain justice?
On their third date he took her back to his surgery and raped her.

fes.d: This is the person who forces another person to have sexual intercourse with him or her against the other person's will.
This is the person who is forced to engage in sexual intercourse against his or her will.
Degree to which event occurs
The rape of a Victim by the Perpetrator.
Manner of performing an action
An act performed by the Perpetrator by which the sexual crime is accomplished.
Result of an event
The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.
Where the event takes place.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
The Time when the event occurs.
This FE is any object used to commit the crime.
The number of times that a rape event takes place.

name: Rashness
d: A Protagonist performs some Action without fully considering the circumstances under which he or she acts, or the possibly (negative) consequences of the Action. Alternatively, the Action itself may be portrayed as having been performed under rushed circumstances.

ex.t: Would it be a little impatient of me to ask when an album might appear?
He was quick to move, alert and forceful, as he was impetuous in attacking an enemy

fes.d: The Protagonist acts or is apt to act with some degree of consideration regarding the circumstances and possible consequences of an Action he or she may perform.
The Action is carried out by the Protagonist with or without regard for the circumstances under which it is performed or consideration of possible consequences.
The period of time when the Protagonist acts with (or without) consideration regarding an Action.
The extent to which the Action of the Protagonist deviates from the expected in its rashness.
The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

name: Rate_description
d: The LUs in this frame describe the level that a Rate, or the variation in some quantity over a period of time, deviates from the norm. The focal Event for which the Rate is relevant may be profiled as metonymically referring to the Rate of the Event. This frame differs from Rate_quantification in that it does not describe the Rate with a specific numerical designation.

ex.t: The rapid increase in obesity is a major cause of concern.
Such systems have a very rapid rate of recovery.

fes.d: The Event whose Rate is being described.
The Rate at which something happens during an Event.
How much the Rate deviates from a neutral or expected standard.
A participant in an Event that is responsible for its unexpected Rate.

name: Rate_quantification
d: An Event occurs that can be characterized by a given Rate. The Rate is a ratio of how much a particular quantity changes over time. Degree compares the the given Rate with a standard or expected rate for a similar Event. The Agent is a participant in the event who is responsible for the Rate.

ex.t: We compared the evolutionary rates of the two different species of monkey.
Graduation rates have not gone up in the last decade.

fes.d: The Event that occurs at a certain Rate.
How much a particular salient quantity involved in an Event changes over time.
Any characterization of the Rate that is not covered by another more specific FE.
A participant in the Event who is responsible for the indicated Rate.
A name of the Rate of or description of the particular category the Rate belongs to.
Degree compares the given rate for the standard or familiar rate for a given Event.

name: Ratification
d: A Ratifier responds to a Proposal constructed by another party to make it binding over the Ratifier's jurisdiction or constituency.

ex.t: The ratification of the Kyoto protocol has been a long, hard slog.
The US is considering ratifying the cybercrime treaty.
The Malaysian government will ratify the UN's anti-smoking programme by the end of the year.

fes.d: The individual or body that confirms a Proposal negotiated or created by another party, causing it to become binding in a jurisdiction represented by the Ratifier. In the case of direct democratic ratification, the jurisdiction and the Ratifier are the same.
The idea or course of action proposed by another individual or body which the Ratifier endorses and makes binding.
The Time is when the Ratifier makes the Proposal binding.
The Place is where the Ratifier ratifies the Proposal.
The Purpose is the goal of the Ratifier when they ratify the Proposal.
The Explanation is the cognitive cause of the Ratifier's ratification.

Any description of the allowing which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Ratifier that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An action of the Ratifier whereby they make binding the Proposal.

name: Reading_activity
d: A Reader visually examines a Text, typically in a linear order, to understand its content. In place of the Text, a Topic may be mentioned. This frame differs from the Reading_perception frame, which obligatorily focuses on the perceptual and cognitive interpretive aspects of reading; unlike Reading_activity, targets in Reading_perception require explicit mention of the Text being examined. While Reading_activity is broad enough to cover the same circumstances as Reading_perception, it also covers situations where reading is contrasted merely with another task or leisure activity, when reading is considered generically, and when the Topic unifying the reading activity replaces mention of a Text. Additionally, this frame differs from Hearsay in that Reading_activity is focused on what the Reader is agentively doing, whereas in Hearsay, the focus is on what the Hearer knows and how they know it. As a result, most valences are unambiguous: full clause complements for the Message point to the Hearsay frame, while Text or lack of any complement indicates the Reading_activity frame. The only overlap is in the case of Topic, where the frames can be still distinguished by factivity of the Topic. In other words, read.v used in the Hearsay frame, just like hear.v in the Hearsay frame, when used with a Topic, indicates clearly that there is some specific fact related to the Topic that the reader or hearer now knows and understands. Thus the first and second of the following sentences belong to Hearsay, the last to Reading_activity:

ex.t: She ca n't read . INI
They read the bible nightly .
I 've read about you !

fes.d: The one who examines a Text to understand it.
The entity that contains linguistic symbols.
Degree to which event occurs
A particular characteristic or thing that the Reader intends to process. Read Chapter 7 only for the major concepts..

Any description of the reading event that implicates details of how the event unfolds or is carried out (e.g. "the same way"); additionally used for descriptions of the Reader that also affect the event (e.g. "eagerly").
An act that allows the Reader to read in the specified manner.
The Purpose is the reason for which the Reader reads the Text.
When the reading event takes place.
Where the reading event takes place.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The context wherein the Reader reads.
The idea that an implicit Text or texts focuses on.
An assessment of how many iterations of (the specified kind of) reading occur per time.

name: Reading_aloud
d: A Speaker interprets a written Text and speaks the contents, usually to an Addressee. The contents may be the Text verbatim or a representation of the text.

ex.t: I do think they read to them when they are little. INI
Inside the flat a fruity voice was reading out a list of figures which had something to do with the production of the pig-iron. DNI

fes.d: The person or people to whom the Speaker is directing the reading of the Text.
The person who reads the Text aloud.
The source from which the Speaker reads.
The way that the Speaker reads the Text aloud.
The medium from which the Text is read.
When the reading takes place.
The result that the Speaker is trying to achieve by reading aloud.
The location at which the reading takes place.
The method by which the Text is read aloud by the Speaker.

name: Reading_perception
d: The Reader attends to a Text to process its information. Sometimes a particular kind of Sought_phenomenon is sought in the Text. The metaphor which allows motion verbs plus "through" to express reading (e.g. "went through the text", "slogging through the phonebook", "sped through the dialogue passages") is considered to be productive, and thus should be annotated in the Motion frames. The metaphor applies most productively to motion verbs that do not specify motor program and either specify no manner information at all (e.g. "go") or only specify the manner of motion in terms of difficulty and/or speed ("slog", "speed"), although other verbs with specific information ("saunter", "swim") may occur in more colorful usage.

ex.t: I read A Tale of Two Cities last night.

fes.d: The one who examines a Text to understand it.
The entity that contains linguistic symbols.
Degree to which event occurs
A particular characteristic or thing that the Reader intends to process. Read Chapter 7 only for the major concepts..
Manner of performing an action
An act that allows the Reader to read in the specified manner.
The Purpose is the reason for which the Reader reads the Text.
When the reading event takes place.
Where the reading event takes place.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.
The context wherein the Reader reads a particular Text.

name: Reason
d: A volitional Agent is responding to a State_of_affairs by performing some Action.

ex.t: And was that your reason for becoming an actor ?
But Giles is the reason that I am here .
Oh my reason for including it was Section fifty four A.

fes.d: The person who responds to a State_of_Affairs by performing some Action.
The action that the Agent performs in response to a State_of_Affairs.
The eventuality that motivates the Agent"s performing a particular Action in response to it.

name: Reasoning
d: An Arguer presents a Content, along with Support, to an Addressee. The Content may refer elliptically to a course of action or it may refer to a proposition that the Addressee is to believe. Some lexical units (e.g. "prove") indicate the speaker's belief about the Content.

ex.t: Jan argued that the evidence was inadmissable.
Jan argued against the admissability of the evidence.
Jan proved  that the evidence was inadmissable.

fes.d: The Arguer wants the Addressee to entertain the Content, which can be a proposition to be believed or a course of action to be taken, based on the Support presented.
This FE identifies the physical or abstract setting in which the Content is conveyed.
The Arguer presents the Content before the Addressee.
Addressee is the entity before whom the Arguer presents a Content.
Support lends epistemic support to a claim, or provides a reason for a course of action.
This FE identifes the Manner in which an Arguer argues.
This FE identifies the Means by which an Arguer presents Content to an Addressee.
Depictive identifies a phrase describing a participant in an action.
This FE identifies the Result of an arguing event.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an arguing event occurs.
The Time at which an Arguer makes an argument for the Content.
This FE identifies the location where an argument is made by an Arguer.
The period of time for which the Arguer presents his or her reasoning to the Addressee.
An entity related to the Content.

name: Reassuring
d: A Speaker conveys a Message to an Experiencer in order to reassure them about a Situation; Medium and the Means of the communication also may be expressed.

ex.t: We reassured him that his decision was sound.

fes.d: The sentient entity that uses language in the written or spoken modality to reassure another person.
The Experiencer receives reassurance from the Speaker.
The Message is a proposition or set of propositions that the Speaker wants the Experiencer to believe in order to feel reassured.
The Situation is the problem plaguing the Experiencer, about which the Speaker reassures them.
The physical or abstract setting in which the Message is conveyed.
The amount of reassurance given.
The Depictive describes the state of the Speaker.
The Manner in which the Speaker reassures the Experiencer.
The Means by which the Speaker reassures the Experiencer.
The Time at which the reassurance takes place.

name: Rebellion
d: An individual or group, the Rebel, rejects the authority of the Current_leadership, and attempts to bring them out of power. The rebellion may, but need not be violent. Rather than expressing rebellion against the Current_leadership, the lexical units in this frame may appear with expressions describing the Current_order, the system of rule which the Rebels reject.

ex.t: In 1641 there was a Catholic rebellion against the Protestants of Ulster, and English authority over the island was shaken.
How do they justify their armed insurgency?

fes.d: The individual or group within a society that attempts to overturn the Current_leadership, and possibly also the Current_order of governance.
The people currently in power, whom the Rebels attempt to overthrow.
The currently-existing system of authority or government.
The location of the rebellion.
The time when the rebellion takes place.
The means by which the Rebel rebels against the authorities.
The degree to which the Rebel opposes and fights against the Current_leadership.
A description of the Rebel or the rebellion not covered by more specific FEs.
The rebellion aims to install a New_order as their leader. This FE is more frequent with noun targets.
A result of the rebellion.
The length of time of the rebellion.

name: Receive_visitor_scenario
d: A (potential) Visitor arrives at a location associated with a (potential) Host. The Host permits the Visitor to enter the location, and allows the Visitor to avail him/herself of available resources, in order to pursue some goal. The visit is often for social or entertainment reasons. After a temporary stay at the Host's location, the Visitor departs.

fes.d: The Host allows the Visitor to remain with him/her to acheive a goal.
The Visitor temporarily remains with the Host in order to achieve his/her purpose.
The goal of the Host in allowing the Visitor to enter the Host's location.

name: Receiving
d: A Recipient comes into possession of the Theme as a result of the joint action of the Donor and the Recipient. The Receiving frame like the Giving frame requires that the Donor first has possession of the Theme and that following the transfer, the Donorno longer has the Theme and the Recipient does.

ex.t: I recieved a box from him in the mail.

fes.d: The person who acts to come into possession of the Theme.
The person who gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The entity that changes possession, beginning in the possession of the Donor and ending up with the Recipient.
The aim of the Donor, which they believe will be accomplished by giving the Theme.
The act that the Recipient performs which brings about their reception of the Theme.
The time at which the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.
The location at which the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.
The system whereby the Theme travels (literally or metaphorically) so that the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.
The state of the Recipient or Theme during the action.
The character of the Recipient which saliently affects the action, or a general description of the action itself.
A good given or a service rendered by the Recipient, in return for wich the Theme is given to the Recipient by the Donor.
When the Theme is received physically by the Recipient from the Donor, the Path of motion of the Theme may be specified.
What the Recipient intends to do with the Theme.
A role that the Theme is intended to fill by the Donor.

name: Receiving_scenario
d: The sequence beginning with the Recipient not having the Theme and ending with the Recipient in possession of the Theme.

fes.d: The person who acts to come into possession of the Theme.
The person who gives the Theme to the Recipient.
The entity that changes possession, beginning in the possession of the Donor and ending up with the Recipient.
The aim of the Recipient, which they believe will be accomplished by accepting the Theme.
The act that the Recipient performs which brings about their reception of the Theme.
The system whereby the Theme travels (literally or metaphorically) so that the Recipient comes into possession of the Theme.

name: Reciprocality
d: This frame characterizes states-of-affairs with Protagonists in relations with each other that may be viewed symmetrically. When the Protagonists are equally prominent, each equally serving to identify the others, they are expressed together as Protagonists. When one of the Protagonists serves to define the other (more or less as a Ground), it is called Protagonist_2, and the other is called Protagonist_1 (i.e. the Figure). This frame exists as a background for a number of lexical frames, including Chatting, Similarity, Exchange, and Being_attached. The most basic frames inheriting from this one are symmetrical states. (For example, Being_attached is symmetrical, since if A is attached to B, B is attached to A.) Other frames exhibiting reciprocality either have a causative/inchoative relation to such a stative frame (e.g. Becoming_attached), or are stative-like summarizations of multiple events of the same kind. This second type, in which events are performed reciprocally, with two equal participants acting on each other, can be exemplified by the Chatting frame in which two people are effectively both speakers and addressees in a joint act of communication. The basic characteristic of this frame, inherited in the daughters, is the equivalence of Protagonist_1 + Protagonist_2 to Protagonists, and the further equivalence (modulo figure/ground profiling) of the following: Protagonist_1 Relation with Protagonist_2. Protagonist_2 Relation with Protagonist_1. Protagonists Relation.

fes.d: The particpant in a reciprocal event that is encoded as the subject of an active-form sentence or as a by-PP in a passive. `
The participant in a reciprocal event that is coded in a with-PP.
The jointly expressed participants in a reciprocal activity.

name: Recording
d: An Agent sets down in permanent form information about the occurrence of a Phenomenon. Alternatively, the Agent records that an Entity had a particular Value for one of its Attributes.

ex.t: While visiting in Port Alberni, the day before he was diagnosed, we recorded him to have 14 drinks and go to the bathroom 10 times.
William Hickey's death is not recorded. CNI
The voter turnout was recorded as over 90 percent. CNI

fes.d: The Agent is the sentient entity that creates a permanent record of the Phenomenon.
The Phenomenon is the entity or situation in the world of which a Agent becomes aware.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
This FE identifes the action whereby the Agent creates a record of the Phenomenon.
This FE identifies the Time when the Agent creates the record of the Phenomenon.
The goal that the Agent has in mind in creating a record of the Phenomenon.
The Agent uses an Instrument in order to create a record of the Phenomenon or to measure an Entity's Value for a specified Attribute.
That feature of the Entity which is under discussion.
The Value of the Entity that is recorded for the specified Attribute.
An Entity for which the Agent records the Value of an Attribute.
Medium is the physical entity in which the Agent creates a record of their impression of the Phenomenon.
The symbolic system used by the Agent.
The location where the Agent sets down the facts.
The extent to which the Phenomenon has been documented.
The amount of times the Agent records something per unit of time.

Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of a continuous situation (the one denoted by the target) to its end. In many cases, the continuous situation is a dynamic action which is ongoing, while in others it is simply an undifferentiated state.
This FE denotes a duration in which the recording event occurred iteratively.

name: Records
d: A Record that contains a permanent account of Data. This Record may be maintained by a Recorder for a certain Entity.

ex.t: The bank's books were not accurate.
He made notes of the subject's responses in the journal by the desk.
She kept a record of how many times Steven had asked her for money.

fes.d: The Record is the entity in which events or accounts are permanently recorded.
The Data is the information which is recorded in the Record. It is often expressed as a prepositional phrase.
The Recorder is the person who records the Data in the Record.
The Entity is the person or institution for which the Record is maintained.
The Type refers to the kind of Record being kept.
A characteristic of the Record.
What a Record is made of (if applicable).
The Medium is the language in which a Record is composed, or the physical medium (radio, ink) in which it is distributed.
The region where the Record is sold, circulated, or otherwise popular
The Time at which the Record was created.
The Title of a Record.
Topic is what the Record is about.
The use for which the Record was produced; its purpose.

name: Recovery
d: These words describe the recovery or healing of a Patient from an Affliction without reference to the influence of any Treatment or Healer (see the Cure frame).

ex.t: My injuries had not yet completely healed.
Henley MP Michael Heseltine, recovering from a heart attack got a very public get well card.

fes.d: The Patient may either be expressed as the External Argument or, as in Health.Cure, may occur as the possessor of the Affliction (an example of FE conflation): In the second example, Pat's wound is the Body_part, but Pat's is also an instantiation of the Patient.
This FE is the injury, pain or disease experienced by the Patient. Affliction occurs either as an External Argument of verbs or as a PP Complement of nouns or verbs:

Where Body Part is expressed as a separate constituent (rather than in phrases such as the wound on Pat's arm), it occurs as an External Argument: Body Part is treated as a separate Frame Element although it may be viewed as metonymic for Affliction.
Manner of performing an action
The extent to which the Patient's state diverges from their former illness.
An act of the Patient that results in their recovery.
An individual or group of individuals that the Patient is generally in the presence of during convalescence.
The time at which the recovery takes place.
The location where the recovery takes place.

name: Redirecting
d: An intentional Agent or a causing event (Cause) event causes a Theme which is already in motion to take a different Path or Direction, or reach a different Goal than the Original_path.

ex.t: The hotel business didn't last - especially after the construction of a railroad diverted travelers a few miles west to what is now the village of Eagle
Pakistan government officials helped and diverted the trucks to another camp in the no-man's land in Mach.
Prior to the arrival of the president's motorcade, the police redirected the protesters away from the main roadonce more.

fes.d: The entity that is in motion, and changes path due to the action of an Agent or due to a Cause.

The route that the Theme was originally headed for. In cases when the Theme is an intentional actor or is controlled by an intentional actor, the Original_path correlates with the (former) plan of the actor. In other cases, the Original_path corresponds to what would be expected for the path of the Theme from general principles or physics. (In some cases, the Original_path may indicate the intended destination, and not just the path, of the Theme.)
The Path refers to (a part of) the ground over which the Theme ends up travelling after being diverted.
The location the Theme ends up in after being redirected.
This FE identifies the Time when the redirection of motion occurs.

Any description of the redirection which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of the Agent that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state of the Theme or Agent during the redirection.
The Place is the location at which the redirection occurs.

This FE is used for expressions that indicate motion along a line from the current deitic center towards a reference point (which may be implicit) that does not necessarily correspond to the Goal. Often Direction is defined with reference to the canonical orientation of the Theme, the orientation imposed by an implicit observer, or the inherent orientation of the scene.
The state-of-affairs that the Agent intends to bring about by redirecting the Theme.
An individual that determines the change in course of the Theme.
An event that brings about the change in the Path of the Theme.
The method by which the Agent redirects the Theme.

name: Reference_text
d: In a text, a Source_of_information is given that provides a reader of the text with further Information relevant to the text. In this frame the author and reader are completely deprofiled, with the Source_of_information made salient.

ex.t: In Densmore's days it was sometimes made of an old-fashioned man's celluloid collar (cf. Densmore 1943: 116).
The 'foaming regions' play the role of 'internal shocks' (cf. Piran's recent publication for a review) of GRB theory.
Use my() for local variables whenever you can get away with it (but see perlform for where you can't).

fes.d: The Source_of_information is referred to as a source of information related to the current text.
The Source_of_information contains Information that the reader is directed to.

name: Referring_by_name
d: A Speaker uses a particular linguistic form, a Name to refer to an Entity. The Entity often is an interlocutor but may be somebody that the Speaker is talking about, or even just a physical object. Note that we include titles such as "Sir" in the Name category.

ex.t: They corresponded frequently and at length, exchanging intimate letters in which he addressed her as Windflower.
We always called her "my lady," from the moment that she was put at the head of our section;
Sharpton called him Obama Baracka in HIS speech .... of all the people to screw his name up!

fes.d: The person who uses the Name to refer to the Entity.
The entity that is designated by the Speaker with the Name used.
The linguistic form used by the Speaker to refer to the Entity.
The point of time or interval when the Speaker uses the Name.
Describes the Name.

name: Reforming_a_system
d: Because it no longer functions adequately under the given circumstances, an Agent (or non-Agentive Cause) undertakes steps to change the structural makeup of a complex Entity with interdependent parts, for instance an institution or a system of laws. The Degree of change is typically gradual and partial rather than revolutionary and total. Note that with some LUs the Entity can be unexpressed when it is identical to the Agent.

ex.t: They want to reform the law on Sunday trading.
At the same time , the government reformed the rating system as it applied to companies.
This study investigates how and why the majority of large Slovak companies restructured without the help of foreign investors or a government. DNI

fes.d: The sentient entity that effects a change in the Entity.
The time at which the change of the Entity is caused.
The extent to which the Entity differs from its former state at the end of the reform.

Any description of the event causing the change of the Entity which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly), general descriptions comparing events (the same way), and salient characteristics of the Agent that also affect the action (carefully).

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which reform event logically follows. In many cases, the state of affairs denoted is specifically one that the Agent takes as a reason for reforming the entity.

This FE denotes a complex, abstract, human-created entity with interdependent parts which has either deteriorated or is no longer adequate for its purpose given a change in circumstances and which the Agent therefore wants to modify.
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by effecting a change in the Entity.
The category of which the Entity is a member before the Agent causes a change in its makeup.
The category that the Entity belongs to after it has undergone the change.
This FE identifies the steps or actions directly enabling reform.
An alternative description of expressed action
This FE is used for phrases that describe the event of reforming as a whole .
This FE describes the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the reform process.
The length of time over which reforming takes place
This FE is for non-human causes, such as a processes or institutions, responsible for reform.
The place where the reformation occurs.

name: Regard
d: A Cognizer has a Judgment of an Evaluee, expressing how high or low their regard for the Evaluee is.

ex.t: What do you think of him as a linguist?
She secretly thought well of him for his role in defrocking Mr. Matthews.
Please understand, I hold you in the highest regard.

fes.d: The Cognizer is the one that makes a Judgment. This role is typically expressed as the External Argument (or in a by-PP in passives).
Evaluee is the person or thing that a judgment is made with respect to. With verbs this FE is typically expressed as Object:
There may be a constituent expressing the Explanation for the Cognizer's judgment. It is usually a for-PP.
Role is used for the capacity in which the Evaluee is judged, and is expressed in as-PPs.
Depictive identifies any expression describing the state of a participant in the event.
Any description of the Cognizer's judgment which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions of events (the same way, presumptuously, secretly).
The Extent_of_acclaim is a description of the number or locales of the Cognizers.
A description (from the point of view of the Cognizer) of the position of the Evaluee on a scale of approval.

name: Region_with_portal
d: A Portal, Exterior, Surface, Boundary, and Interior are picked out relative to a Ground.

fes.d: A region of space located inside a Ground.
An entity whose location is relatively well-known and which, thus, can serve as a land-mark to identify the Interior, Surface, or Boundary.
The region located outside of, but in contact with, the Ground.
The region associated with the boundary of the Ground.
The region which is not located inside or in contact with the Ground.

name: Rejuvenation
d: The action of an Agent or the occurrence of a Cause event returns an Entity to an earlier state of vigor and strength.

ex.t: Falling prices and wireless connectivity have breathed new life into the PDA market.
While Paul Reubens resuscitates his career, Pee-wee fans use the Web to keep the 'adventure' alive.
Athens' democracy was unexpectedly reinvigorated by its great defeat.

fes.d: The concrete or abstract thing that is brought into an earlier state in which it was more effective and powerful.
The Agent puts the Entity into a state of renewed vigor.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent brings about the change in the Entity's state.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent brings about the revitalization of the Entity.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent causes the renewal of the Entity.
This FE identifies the action that the Agent performs in order so as to bring about the reinvigoration of the Entity.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Domain within which the Entity is affected.
The number of times that an Entity is caused to return to a more effective state.
An event or state whose occurrence brings about the Entity's return to a vigorous state.
This FE is used for phrases that describe the clause of the target as a whole, either appraisals of the event, or descriptions of the rejuvenation event as role fillers in other frames.
This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often.
This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.
The device used by the Agent to help accomplish the action indicated by the target.
Role is used for the capacity in which the Entity is Rejuvinated, and is expressed in as-PPs.
The end state of the Rejuvination action.

name: Relating_concepts
d: A Concept_1 is related to Concept_2 by some Evidence.

ex.t: The single remaining piece of evidence linked Kirov the tailor to Kirov the dissident activist.
There is ample data relating earnings to years of schooling.

fes.d: The concept which is linked to Concept_2.
The concept which is tied to Concept_1.
The point of view from which the connection exists.
The phenomenon that points to or proves the connection between Concept_1 and Concept_2. Generally expressed as an external.
The Circumstances under which the connection exists.
The two concepts expressed jointly.
The Degree of connection between the Concepts.
A further specification on the linkage.

name: Relation
d: A relation holds between Entity_1 and Entity_2.

ex.t: I see no relation between these animals.

fes.d: An entity with a relationship to Entity_2.
The entity with a relationship to Entity_1.
The things that are related to each other. Collective expression of the FEs Entity_1 and Entity_2.
A characterization of the relation that determines what model is active for further reasoning.

name: Relation_between_individuals
d: Two sentient beings have a permanent or semi-permanent Relation to each other. This relation may be symmetrically construed as between the Individuals or it may be construed assymetrically, such that Individual_1 is identified by their relation to the (implicitly better-known) Individual_2.

fes.d: The individual being described in terms of Individual_2.
The individual whose identity serves to identify Individual_2.
The type of connection between the Individuals.
The individuals in a (symmetrically construed) Relation to each other.

name: Relational_location
d: This is a general frame that identifies a Profiled_region whose configuration is specified by an image schema (specified in more specific child frames) and located relative to a Ground.

fes.d: The region which is located relative to the Ground and which is shaped according to an image schema.
Salient parts that make up a Profiled_region.
A place that a Profiled_region is located with respect to.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the Profiled_region about. This FE should also include words that indicate that there was no salient formation.
The location that the Profiled_region is a part of.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Profiled_region.

An event related to the Profiled_region in some way other than (1) Formational_cause (which is a separate FE) or an intended use (which would place the instance in Locale_by_use), or (3) a defining event (which would place the instance in Locale_by_event).
The activity that is carried out in the Profiled_region.
An entity whose location is relatively well-known and which, thus, can serve as a land-mark to identify the Profiled_region.

name: Relational_natural_features
d: The Focal_feature is defined in relation to a Landmark_feature, either as a particular part, or as an immediately bordering entity.

ex.t: I'm on the summit of Mt. Shasta.

fes.d: Salient parts of the Focal_feature.
The location that the Focal_feature is a part of.
Indicates the action (or causer) which brings the features of the Focal_feature about.
A stable bounded area defined by its relation to another landform. This FE is incorporated in each LU in this frame.
This FE is used for the Names of Focal_features.
A place that a Focal_feature is located with respect to.
The Type is the subtype of natural feature.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Focal_feature which is not covered by more specific FEs.
The landform with respect to which the Focal_feature is defined.

name: Relational_political_locales
d: A Locale is defined politically to be the head of state of another, larger political locale, the Container_possessor.

ex.t: She had repeatedly been to the capital of the nation, and there had met with a reception none too cordial.
He decided to stay in the capital of Iraq for two months while he recuperated to fight another day.
The largest city in the area, Oakland is the county seat of Alameda county.

fes.d: The materials or Constituent_parts that make up a Locale.
The political locale that the Locale is a the head of.
The politically or administratively-defined locale that functions as the head of state for the containing entity.
This FE is used for the Names of Locales.
A place that the Locale is located with respect to.
Any description, characteristic, or property of the Locale which is not covered by more specific FEs.
The people living in the jurisdiction of the locale, typically expressed with a PP-of.

name: Relational_quantity
d: A quantity, the Numerator, can be understood in terms of how it relates to another quantity, the Denominator; the comparison of these two numbers is called the Rate. The nouns in this frame may denote the Rate unless the referent is specifically expressed. This frame is a general description of the relationship between any two dependent quantities; children of this frame may describe situations in which the scale of the Numerator and/or the Denominator is fixed.

ex.t: I'm not paying the high interest rates.
The nest egg is going to be taxed at a federal rate of about 55 percent.
This assumption is commonly adopted in statistical models that are used to estimate the transmission rate of HIV.

fes.d: The number which represents the relative quantities of the Numerator and the Denominator.
Identifies the quantity whose magnitude is determined relative to the Denominator.
The set of things to which the Rate pertains.
Any characteristic of the Rate that is not covered by another more specific FE.
A name of the Rate of or description of the particular category the Rate belongs to.
The quantity whose magnitude is determined relative to the Numerator.

name: Relative_time
d: These words relate to the relative ordering of two events or times. There are two major types of relations evoked by the words of this frame. Some of the words (e.g. follow.v, antecedent.a, previous.a) describe the (definitively) stative relationship between two events (the Landmark_occasion and the Focal_occasion). This first type will be moved to the Time_vector frame. Others (e.g. belated.a, early.a) refer to the change or deviation of an event from the Landmark_occasion (which is expected or usual at a particular time) to the Focal_occasion (which occurs at a different time). Quite often, a Focal_participant who is saliently involved in the Focal_occasion stands in for the occasion.

ex.t: After she arrived , she laid out her papers on the desk.
The following morning, she tried to figure out what it meant . DNI
My flight is early by 20 minutes.

fes.d: The Focal_occasion is the event which is being located in time with respect to some other event: The Focal_occasion is profiled, in contrast to the Landmark_occasion, which is backgrounded.
The Landmark_occasion is the event with respect to which the Focal_occasion is located.
Frequently, the Interval between the Reference and Focal Occasions is expressed: The article in the Times closely followed the singer's announcement that he was retiring.
Degree to which event occurs
Manner of performing an action
This FE is used for the Explanation or explanation for the Focal_occasion being early or late.
The Focal_participant is the participant in the Focal_occasion which is profiled as being in a relation of relative time to the Landmark_occasion.

name: Releasing
d: A Captor ends the captivity or inhibition of the motion of a Theme from the Location_of_confinement. The release is in accord with the plans of the Captor.

ex.t: They released me from prison on New Year's Day.

fes.d: The Captor is the individual who ends the confinement or captivity of the Theme. The release of the Theme is in accord with the plans of the Captor.
The Theme is the person or object in motion released by the Captor.

Any description of the release which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Captor that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The action of the Captor which brings about the release.
The Explanation identifies the reason for which the Captor are releasing the Theme.
The Purpose identifies the purpose for which the Captor release the Theme.
The location where the Theme ceases to be confined.
The Time identifies when the Captor release the Theme .
The location to which the Theme's motion was formerly inhibited.

This FE signifies that the state of affairs expressed by the main clause (containing the target) occurs or holds, and something other than that state of affairs would be expected given the state of affairs in the concessive clause.
The state of the world when the Releasing event occurs.

name: Releasing_from_custody
d: The Authorities release a Suspect who has been held under suspicion of having committed a crime.

fes.d: The Authorities are those who have the official authority to release a Suspect.
The Suspect is the person released by the Authorities, having been held under suspicion of having committed a crime.
The Manner is the way in which the Authorities release the Suspect.
The Means identifies the means by which the Authorities release the Suspect.
The Explanation identifies the reason for which the Authorities are releasing the Suspect.
The Purpose identifies the purpose for which the Authorities release the Suspect.
The Place identifies the place where the Authorities release the Suspect .
The Time identifies when the Authorities release the Suspect .
The place that the Suspect is no longer confined to.

name: Reliance
d: A Protagonist needs a Means action performed for their Benefit. The relevant Means action is often evoked only by reference to an Intermediary who performs it. Also, if the Protagonist performs the Means action themselves, the Instrument that they use may be referred to in place of the Means Note that when one of the three interrelated FEs Means, Instrument and Intermediary is realized overtly, the other two are blocked from overt realization as clause-level arguments of the target. When the Protagonist is a sentient being, it is implied that they put their trust in the Intermediary to help in the achievement of the Benefit. The extent to which the Protagonist is dependent on an Intermediary or Instrument can be indicated in a Degree phrase. A set of Circumstances in which the Protagonist's need for the Benefit arises, may also be specified. The difference between the Benefit that the Means action provides and the Purpose that the Protagonist has is very subtle. For our purposes we will assume that one can form a predication from Benefit and Means on the one hand, and Protagonist and Purpose on the other, but that they cannot be intermingled (cf. examples (7) and (8) below). With for-PPs such as in (6) it is not clear which FE they instantiate, Benefit or Purpose. We will arbitrarily call them Benefit

ex.t: (1) I rely on you to see that my name is not sullied.
(2) The system can rely entirely on coaxial cable or entirely on optical fibre, just as a tree and branch network can be based on either technology .
(3) The Tories had got him into this and he relied on them to get him out.

fes.d: The person or thing whose needs are served by the Means action.
An action or state that the Means action brings about and from which the Protagonist profits.
The extent to which the achievement of the Benefit depends on the Means action.
The person or thing that performs a Means action to the Benefit of the Protagonist.
An object that the Protagonist uses to realize a Benefit.
An action or state that the Protagonist wants to bring about. It is more or less the Benefit viewed in relation to the Protagonist rather than the Means.
An action performed either by the Protagonist or an Intermediary that has a Benefit for the Protagonist attached to it.
The conditions when the Protagonist needs to rely on an Instrument or Intermediary.

name: Reliance_on_expectation
d: A Cognizer takes a certain Expectation to be a reliable fact, such that their plans can be based on it.

ex.t: I can always count on him being late to work when it's raining.

fes.d: An individual that considers the Expectation certain.
The fact which the Cognizer depends on in planning for the future.
The situation in which the Cognizer can count on the Expectation.

name: Religious_belief
d: A Believer has faith in a piece of Content or an Element which fits into a religious belief system made up of many articles of faith. The Content is not necessarily tied to direct sensory experience. The system of beliefs may be enshrined by the members of a social group

ex.t: Do Muslims believe in the virgin birth of Jesus?
Muslims believe in only One God, the same God that Jews and Christians believe in, but some of the ideas about the nature of God are different
Muslims believe that the month of Ramadan is the holiest month of the year

fes.d: The Believer is the person whose religious beliefs are in question.
The Content is the object of the Believer's religious conviction. Content can be expressed as a finite clause or in a in-PP Complement.
This FE identifies the Degree to which the Believer is convinced of the usefulness and validity of their religious beliefs .
This FE identifies the Manner in which the Believer knows or thinks something.
Role is a function that an Element of the faith is believed to serve.
A predefined, fixed idea to which reference is made throughout the belief system.

name: Remainder
d: A Resource is depleted by some process, resulting in there being only a Remainder in existence some time into or after the process. The original Resource may be indicated metonymically via reference to an Original_owner. The Location where the Resource is found may be expressed.

ex.t: There are only two poems left from Quayle
After the storm, only two houses were left DNI
Not much was left in the till

fes.d: The part of the Resource that the Process has not yet applied to.
The original set of items to which the Depletive_process applies one after the other.
The place where the Resource is found.
The individual who owned the Resource that is being depleted.
The Time when the amount of the Resource that is let is assessed.
An individual who may use the Remainder for his benefit.

A temporal setting or event which metonymically stands for the entities that were in existence then. The Remainder is part of the Original_context. This FE occurs especially when abstract entities such as social institutions are seen as Resources.

name: Remembering_experience
d: A Cognizer calls up an episodic memory of past Experience or an Impression of a Salient_entity formed on the basis of past experience. The Cognizer may also remember the Salient_entity in a particular State, which serves as a frame of reference in the Cognizer's mind. When attention is focused on a Salient_entity, then mention of a global Experience is excluded and typically, but not always, either a State or Impression of the Salient_entity is presented. Episodic memory is the explicit memory of events. It includes time, place, and associated emotions (which affect the quality of the memorization). Episodic memory contrasts and interacts with semantic memory, the memory of facts and concepts. The Remembering_information frame is concerned with this latter type of memory.

ex.t: Kozmo could remember when his modem was the fastest he could buy.
That's probably before my time, which was long time ago, Fish may remember that time.
Who remembers me being a total dork and going up to everyone saying "Hey, I'm Ashley Hunt from Chicago"!?!

fes.d: A person who recalls memories of past experience or impressions.
A person or thing that the Cognizer remembers as being involved in some state or event or as having some property.
A past event or state that the Cognizer witnessed and is now recalling. The Experience may be a specific event or state or a vaguer period that is treated as a unit.
A property that the Cognizer attributes to the Salient_entity based on their past experience of the Salient_entity or a category to which the Salient_entity is assigned.
A property or role that a Salient_entity actually held and which frames the memories that the Cognizer has of the Salient_entity.
The degree of detail and/or immediacy of a remembered Experience.
A situation in which the Cognizer encountered the Salient_entity.
The time when the Cognizer remembers the experience.

Any description of the event (or state) which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously) and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Cognizer that affect the action (fondly).
The amount of time for which the Cognizer remembers the experience.

name: Remembering_information
d: A Cognizer retains facts in memory and is able to retrieve them. The Mental_content may be presented in clearly propositional form as a finite clause. It may also take the form of an embedded question or be a concealed question in the form of a simple NP. Notice that this frame is very general. It can be used to talk about detailed reports of past experience. Notice that Mental_content reported within this frame is presented as factive, i.e. as reliable and accurate. Consider the following contrasts: The (b) sentences, which belong in this frame, are less acceptable than the (a)-sentences as they suggest that the Cognizer takes their memory to be accurate while suggesting at the same time that the memory might be or is inaccurate. In the (a) sentences, which belong to the Remembering_experience frame, there is no contradiction as the remembering is taken to be subjective and not necessarily accurate. The concealed question uses with personal names that occur in this frame are not always easy to distinguish from instances of the Remembering_experience frame where a Salient_entity alone is referred to in 3a and 3b, which belong to the Remembering_experience frame, there is no question of identity: remembering here means thinking of one's memories of the relevant person. 3c is different: the hearer is asked whether they know who the person is; it belongs in this frame. This frame differs from Remembering_to_do in that this frame is strictly talking about a fact, whereas the Remembering_to_do frame is strictly about tasks which the Cognizer would be expected to do. Remembering_to_do uses normally occur with infinitival complements.

ex.t: I was impressed that she 'd actually remembered Radish 's name (= what Radish's name is)
Oh, and for those who like to continually whinge about how the French are 'surrender monkeys' - remember Napoleon (= who Napoleon was)?
I ca n't remember what DSP stands for.

fes.d: The person who retains and retrieves information.
Mental_content stored by and accessible to the Cognizer. It may derive from experience or activity or simply from being informed of it.
The extent to which the remembered Mental_content matches the information or experience that it is based on.
The time when the Cognizer retrieves Mental_content or forgets it.
An entity, concrete or abstract, or an event that the remembered Mental_content is about.
A situation or a text from which the Mental_content was acquired.

name: Remembering_to_do
d: A Cognizer thinks of and performs an Action that is a self- or other-imposed task or some other kind of desirable behavior. The Action may involve a Salient_entity in some way affected by the Cognizer. If a Salient_entity is mentioned, the Action is left unexpressed.

ex.t: You invited everybody but you forgot Harry.
Thank God Smithers remembered to return the video..
If you forget your textbook and there is an assignment to be done, the highest grade you will receive on the work is aC (70%).

fes.d: The person who thinks of or fails to think of an obligatory or desireable Action.
An Action that the Cognizer is supposed to carry out. This may be a Task imposed specifically on the Cognizer or it may be self- or socially imposed.
A Time when the Cognizer remembers or fails to carry out an Action.
The Salient_entity is a person or thing that the Cognizer needs to affect or effect when carrying out the Action.
This FE describes how often the Action is performed by the Cognizer.

name: Removing
d: An Agent causes a Theme to move away from a location, the Source. The Sourceis profiled by the words in this frame, just as the Goal is profiled in the Placing frame.

ex.t: I saw that several men in dark suits had removed all of the evidence from the scene.
With your index finger prise the meat out of the shell
The torrential winds dislodged most of the roof tiles.

fes.d: The Agent is the person (or other force) that causes the Theme to move.
Theme is the object that changes location.

The Source is the initial location of the Theme, before it changes location. A few of the words in this frame participate in an alternation between a Theme object and a Source object. Sentences with a Source object belong in the frame Motion_Emptying. The frames Motion_Emptying and Motion_Removing differ in terms of which frame element, the Source or the Theme, is construed as being more highly affected.
Any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal expresses the frame element Path. In this frame, Path expressions almost always have a via-sense.
The Goal is the location where the Theme ends up. This Frame Element is not profiled by words in this frame, though it may occasionally be expressed, as with the word remove.

Any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion expresses the frame element Manner. Descriptions of speed, steadiness, grace, means of motion, and other things count as Manner expressions.
The Means is an act whereby the Agent achieves the removal.
Result of an event
Degree to which event occurs
The non-Agentive cause of the removing event.
The Distance is any expression which characterizes the extent of motion. This frame element occurs throughout the motion domain but is very infrequent in Motion_Noise.

The Means_of_motion expresses the conveyance with which the Agent effects the motion of the Theme. The Means_of_motion holds and conveys the Theme. Means_of_motions can move in any way and in any medium. They are usually expressed obliquely with 'in' or 'by'.
The Cotheme is the second moving object, expressed as a direct object or an oblique.
The time at which the removal takes place.
The location where the removal takes place.

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the state of affairs expressed by the target, but not in all cases.
The tool the Agent uses to remove the Theme from its Source.
This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action.
An event the punctuates the larger Removing event.
The state of the world when the Agent or Cause removes the Theme from the Source.
To what end the Agent or Cause removes the Theme.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.
This FE is used to indicate the Direction that the Theme travels when it is removed.

name: Removing_scenario
d: The abstract scene in which an Agent affects a Source and a Theme so that the Theme ends up not co-located with the Source.

fes.d: The Agent is the entity that does the emptying.
The Theme, when overtly expressed, invariably occurs in a PP Complement headed by "of".
The Source is the region or container which is emptied of something. In this frame, the Source occurs as an NP Object.
The Path is any description of a trajectory of motion which is neither a Source nor a Goal.
The Goal is any expression which tells where the Theme ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion.
The Degree to which the Agent empties the Source.
Depicitive phrase describing either the Agent or Theme of the emptying.
The Manner in which the Agent empties the Source.
The Means by which the Agent empties the Source.
The Result of the Agent emptying the Source.
This is the object with which the Agent empties the Source.
The Cause is the non-sentient force which instigates the emptying.
The location where the emptying takes place.
The time at which the emptying takes place.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the target's proposition, but not in all cases.
Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

name: Render_nonfunctional
d: An Agent affects an Artifact so that it is no longer capable of performing its inherent function.

ex.t: I broke the TV.

fes.d: The sentient entity causes the Artifact to not function.
The device that no longer works.
An event that the Agent hopes to bring about by breaking an Artifact.
The action that the Agent performs which results in the Artifact being inoperable.
An inanimate entity or force that renders the Artifact non-functional.
The time at which the event takes place.
The place at which the event takes place.
A holistic description of the event (e.g. the same way), including depictions of the Agent in terms of how the state of the Agent affects the overall action (e.g maliciously).

Meaning: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time. A Frequency expression answers the question how often. It is to be distinguished from Iteration, which pertains simply to the number of times an event occurs--Iteration expressions answer the question how many times.
Degree to which event occurs
The length of time that the Artifact is (or has been) rendered nonfunctional.
This FE is used for any Depictive phrase describing the state of particpant while lack of functionality is being rendered.

name: Renting
d: A Lessee gains the use of Goods owned by a Lessor by payment to the Lessor.

ex.t: We are renting our apartment from a kind man named Tom.

fes.d: The individual that gains temporary use of the Goods by paying the Lessor
The FE Goods is an item which is temporarily exchanged for Money in a transaction.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for tempory use of the Goods.
In isome cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The individual who has permanent ownership of the Goods and allows them to be used by the Lessee temporarily.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The location the renting takes place.
The purpose for which the renting is performed.
A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.
When the event occurs.

Any description of the purchasing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Lessee that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The individual intended by the Lessee to receive the Goods.
The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
The Lessee's intended purpose for the Goods.

name: Renting_out
d: A Lessor who owns some Goods allows a Lessee to use the Goods temporarily in exchange for Money.

ex.t: I rented my cabin to him.

fes.d: The Lessee has Money and wants the Goods.
The FE Goods is the item which is temporarily exchanged for Money.
The means by which a commercial transaction occurs.
Money is the thing given in exchange for Goods in a transaction.
In some cases, price or payment is described per unit of Goods.
The Lessor has possession of the Goods and temporarily exchanges them for Money from a Lessee.
This FE is any unit in which goods or services can be measured. Generally, it occurs in a by-PP.
The location where the leasing takes place.
The purpose for which an intentional act is performed.
A state-of-affairs from which the renting logically follows.
The time at which the renting takes place.

Any description of the renting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of the Lessor that affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The state of the Lessor after the sale has occurred.
The length of time that the Goods are (or have been) in the Lessee's possession.
The Lessee's intended purpose for the Goods.
This FE indicates that the selling act reverses an earlier separate act in which the current Lessor rented or bought the Goods from the current Lessee.
This FE indicates that the current leasing constitues a re-lease by the current Lessor of Goods that they bought or rented earlier from a third person (not the Lessee of the current leasing act).

name: Renunciation
d: A Speaker declares that they will no longer be involved with the Content. Such a declaration implies that the Speaker has decided that association with the Content is somehow undesirable.

ex.t: That will only be possible if and when the IRA renounces armed struggle.

fes.d: The Speaker is the person who communicates their cessation of association with the Content.
The Addressee is the person to whom the Speaker is communicating. When this FE is expressed, it often appears in a prepositional phrase introduced by "to", or as a direct object.
The idea that the Speaker no longer associates with, whether it be an activity, a propostion, or a group.

Any description of the renunciation which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Speaker that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
An act whereby the Speaker makes a statement of renunciation.
The emotional or physical state of the Speaker that leads to their renunciation.
Medium is the physical entity or channel used by the Speaker to transmit the statement of renunciation.
The state of the Speaker during the statement.
The time when the statement is made.
The FE specifies the place where the statement takes place.

This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

name: Reparation
d: The words in this frame describe the process of making amends for some (wrongful) action (the Injury) committed by the Wrongdoer. In this process, in order to appease the Injured_party or to follow laws or customs, the Wrongdoer performs some Benefiting_action for the Injured_party or gives the Injured_party some Gift.

ex.t: I will make it up to you.
Sinn Fein said that the marchers had to make restitution to the Catholics for the disruption and violence.
The tribesmen tried to make amends to us with handfuls of their most precious seashells.

fes.d: The Injured_party was affected by some previous wrongful act of the Wrongdoer and who should benefit from the reparations.
The Injury is the injurious action that the Wrongdoer committed against the Injured_party. Although conceptually present, this FE need not always be realized.
The Wrongdoer makes amends to the Injured_party for the Injury.
The Benefiting_action is performed by the Wrongdoer to make amends.
Gift identifies the entity that the Wrongdoer gives to the Injured_party.

Manner marks any description of the Wrongdoer's making of reparations not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification, (e.g. probably), and general descriptions comparing events (e.g. the same way). It may indicate salient characteristics of a Wrongdoer that also affect the action ( e.g. presumptuously).
This FE identifies the Place where the Wrongdoer makes amends.
This FE identifies the Time when amends are made.
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Wrongdoer makes restitution to the Injured_party.
The extent to which the Wrongdoer makes amends for the Injury .

name: Repayment
d: A Debtor gives a Loaner Money in return for having borrowed Money at an earlier time. Alternatively, the type of Loan can be expressed as the object of repayment.

ex.t: I am paying back $2,000 of my student loan to the government.

fes.d: The person who is owed Money by the Debtor.
The person who is giving Money to the Loaner to return an earlier borrowed amount.
The amount of Money that the Debtor gives to the Loaner, which may or may not be the full amount of the Loan.
A situation or a representative of a situation prior to repayment in which the Debtor uses the Loaner's money.
The level to which the Loan can be considered repaid in its entirety.
When the Debtor gives the Loaner money.
The state of the world when the Money is transfered.
How the Debtor gives Money to the Loaner.
The physical location where the repayment takes place.
What the Debtor does in order to repay the Loaner.

name: Repel
d: A Defender successfully repels the aggressive attempt of takeover by an Enemy.

ex.t: We repelled the invaders.

fes.d: The Enemy is the entity that fails to overtake the Defender.
The Defender is the land, government, and its people that the Enemy fails to seize.
This FE describes the intensity and extent of the repelling event.
The manner in which the Defender repels the Enemy.
The action by which the repelling event is made possible through the efforts of the Defender.
The location where the Defender repels the Enemy.
The Time when the Defender succeeds to repel the Enemy.
The reason why the Defender repels the Enemy.
The tool used by the Defender to repel the Enemy.
This FE refers to the Invasion_act perpetrated by the Enemy.
This FE describes the outcome of the repelling event.

name: Replacing
d: An Agent changes the filler of a Role by placing a New filler in the position after the Old filler ceases to occupy the position. Often this entails the Agent removing the Old filler. In most cases the Role is implicit.

ex.t: If you replace me with a robot, who's gonna make excuses to your wife for you?
Following Keating 's resignation from the Cabinet Hawke immediately replaced him as Deputy Prime Minister with Brian Howe , Minister for Community Services and Health.

fes.d: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the replacement.
The conscious entity, generally a person, that performs actions resulting in the New entity occupying the position.
An entity directed by the Agent that interacts with an New entity so that it ends up in the position.
This FE identifies where the Agent installs the New entity.
This FE identifies the purpose for which an Agent places the New entity in a position.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent installs the New entity.
The New entity is the person or thing that the Agent sets to fill a Role.

Any description of the event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics or states of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in placing the New filler in a position.
The extent to which the New entity is affected by the Agent. Degrees of replacement are generally only possible when there are multiple New and Old entities.
The entity that formerly occupied the position.
The category that the New and Old entities fit into as a result of the function they serve.

name: Reporting
d: In this frame an Informer informs the Authorities of the illegal or otherwise improper Behavior of the Wrongdoer.

ex.t: Tony reported Michael to the police for breaking into his car.
The teacher reported the bathroom vandalism. DNI

fes.d: The Informer reports the activities of the Wrongdoer to the Authorities.
The Wrongdoer has his or her activities reported to the Authorities.
The Authorities are the officials, government or otherwise, who handle misbehavior.
The Behavior is the action or actions for which the Wrongdoer is reported.
The Time when the Informer reports the Behavior of the Wrongdoer.
The Place is the location where the reporting occurs.
The Purpose is the purpose for which the Informer reports the Wrongdoer.

name: Representative
d: A Representative is authorized by a Represented to communicate on behalf of the Represented.

ex.t: She is a representative for Pepsi.

fes.d: The Origin is the place where the Representative was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.
The Representative speaks for another.
The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Representative which is concieved of as persisting over time.
The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Representative.
The Age is the length of time the Representative has been alive.
The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Representative belongs.
An expression indicating the context with which the Representative is associated.
Rank is the position in a hierarchy that a Representative occupies within an organization.
This FE identifies the Place where the Representative works.
The Represented authorizes the Representative to communicate on its behalf.
This FE identifies the Type of Representative.
The Compensation is the payment that the Representative receives for performing a task.
The Contract_basis describes the conditions of employment with respect to permanency, hours per time period, or payment basis.

name: Representing
d: An Entity represents some Phenomenon through its existence and/or defining characteristics. Sometimes a Cognizer, a people or group of people who believe in the representation, is expressed.

ex.t: A bear symbolizes strength in some cultures.

fes.d: The event, idea, or emotion evoked by the Entity.
This FE describes the Degree to which the Entity represents the Phenomenon.
The time period in which the representing occurs.
This FE describes the means through which the representing occurs.
An object that has some association with a Phenomenon.
The Cognizer is the person or group of people who believe in the representation.
The Frequency denotes how often the Entity is associated with the Phenomenon.
The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the represenation logically follows.
The Place where the representing event occurs.

name: Request
d: In this frame a Speaker asks an Addressee for something, or to carry out some action.

ex.t: The customer demanded a refund.
I begged my parents to let me stay up late.

fes.d: The Speaker, as in other communication frames, is generally an External Argument.
In this frame the Addressee can either occur as an NP Object (usually with a following complement clause) or as a PP Complement of verbs or nouns.
The Message is the content of the request that can be expressed as a quote, in a finite or non-finite clausal Complement, an NP Object or PP Complement.
The Topic is rarely expressed in this frame but can occur as a PP Complement headed by about.
The Medium is the physical entity or channel used to transmit the Message. The Medium is frequently expressed as a PP Complement headed by on or in.
Manner indicates the manner in which the Message is delivered.
An act performed by the Speaker that results in a request being made and received.
The interval during which the Speaker makes the request.
This extra-thematic FE applies to participants that are expected to derive a benefit from the occurrence of the event specified by the target predicate.
This FE denotes an event that occurs, or a state of affairs that holds, at a time that includes some time that the request was occuring. This often makes us of "as" and "while".
The frame element Iterations is used for expressions that indicate the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.

This FE describes a participant of the state of affairs introduced by the target as being in some state during the action. The depicted state does not necessarily or usually facilitate or cause the state of affairs reported by the target.

name: Request_entity
d: A Customer requests an Entity from a Supplier. The Customer can order the Entity himself or via a Medium.

ex.t: I ordered a black scarf from J. Crew a week ago.
Mr. Strom's order has been cancelled.

fes.d: The Customer is the person or business ordering the Entity from the Supplier.
The object ordered by the Customer.
The channel used by the Customer to transmit the request.
The person or organization from whom the Customer orders the Entity.
The Time at which the Customer requested the Entity.
The person or organization which benefits from the Entity.
The Manner in which the request is placed.
An action performed by the Customer that results in a request being made.

name: Required_event
d: Unless a particular Required_situation obtains, Negative_consequences will follow. Alternatively, the Required_situation is required to achieve a Purpose (which avoids Negative_consequences). A set of Circumstances may be specified under which the requirement holds. Most, but not all, LUs of this frame are usable in a context that implies a duty or responsibility, concepts related to the Being_obligated frame. However, our analysis is that such interpretations are due to contextual pragmatic strengthening--in other words, a duty is a frequently salient type of purpose that has negative consequences if not achieved.

ex.t: You must turn in your test by 5 p.m.
You better have that fixed by tomorrow or else we'll fire you.
The book needs to be shorter to sell to such a young audience.

fes.d: The state-of-affairs which prevents Negative_consequences.
An event or state of affairs that results if the required Required_situation does not occur and which impacts some deprofiled entity in a way that the speaker finds undesirable.
The FE Circumstances encodes a setting, often temporal or spatial, within which the requirement holds.
The event or state of affairs that is achieved by bringing about the Required_situation and which entails the non-occurrance of Negative_consequences.
The period during which the Required_situation is necessary to prevent negative consequences.
The location within which the Required_situation is required.
The reason why the Required_situation is necessary.

The degree to which the Required_situation is necessary. The Degree may either imply a modification of the direness of the Negative_consequences, the probability of the Negative_consequences (if the Required_situation is not made to hold), or both.

name: Requirement_scenario
d: One state of affairs, the Dependent, cannot occur without another state of affairs, the Requirement, also obtaining. This Requirement is construed to be under the control of some implicit force or actor. In an alternative construal, the Dependent state of affairs may be presented as depending on the presence of a Required_entity. Individual that profit from the occurrence of the Dependent state, Dependent_individuals, are backgrounded. The same goes for individuals (Required_individual) that are required to provide any Required_entity or to see to the occurrence of the Dependent state of affairs. The nexus between Requirement and Dependent can be qualified further in terms of the Degree of strength of the link between the two eventualities, the Place and Time where this nexus obtains, the Reason for its existence, or a specification of Condition when it applies.

fes.d: The state-of-affairs which cannot hold without the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs that must be present or obtain in order for the Dependent to obtain.
The extent to which the Dependent depends on the presence of the Requirement.
The state-of-affairs which militates that the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent to obtain.
The time at which the Requirement is necessary for the Dependent.
The conditions under which the the Requirement is necessary.
The field of endeavor whose nature imposes the Requirement.
