d: As is usual for locative relations, the location of the Figure is specified as being inside a region defined relative to the Ground. In this case, the region measures outward from the Ground with a width specified by the Distance.

ex.t: The number of large galaxies within 5 million light years is three. DNI
What 's within 100 miles of you ?
Two of Russia's long-range bombers flew around Iceland last Friday -- coming within striking distance of the United States for the first time in five or six years .

fes.d: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure, as inside a region measured outward from the Ground and of a width specified by Distance.
The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.
This FE identifies the Distance between the Ground and the borders of the region within which the Figure is located.

name: Word_relations
d: One linguistic unit, Sign_1, has a relation to another linguistic unit, Sign_2. This relation may be semantic, phonological, orthographic, or distributional in nature. The parameter along which the two signs are set in relation to each other is incorporated in the meaning of the target words in this frame. When the relation is symmetrical, the two linguistic units can be expressed jointly, Signs. Otherwise they have to be expressed disjointly. Ordinarily it is assumed that one linguistic unit has exactly one meaning but in cases where this is not so, a set of Circumstances may be specified that helps pick out the relevant sense.

ex.t: Happy and sad are antonyms.
In one sense, dog is a hyponym of itself.

fes.d: FN: a linguistic unit that carries semantic, phonological or syntactic information.
FN: a linguistic unit
FN: Linguistic units
The Circumstances are conditions under which the relationship holds between Sign_1 and Sign_2.

name: Work
d: An Agent expends effort towards achieving a Goal. Alternatively, a Salient_entity involved in the Goal can be expressed in place of a Goal expression.

ex.t: In addition, our organization will work on improving accountability in every department.
If somebody is working on the pipes of your house and you turn on the faucet hard, you get sand, junk.
You could see several students plugging away at the problem.

fes.d: The Agent puts effort into reaching Goal.
The Goal is what the Agent expends effort to achieve.
The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.
This FE identifies the Means by which the effort is done.
This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.
This FE identifies the Time when the effort occurs.
The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.
The place where the work is done.
The Manner in which the Agent puts in effort in acheiving the Goal.
The time peiod over which the work takes place.
The reason for which the Agent puts effort into achieving the Goal.

Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.
The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.
The domain or area within which the work towards the Goal belongs.
An entity that is centrally involved in the Goal that the Agent is attempting to acheive.
How often the Agent works.
This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness.
Descriptor covers any characterization or description of the target that is not covered by another more specific FE.

name: Working_a_post
d: The Agent is assigned to a Post where he or she performs a task associated with that Post. Alternatively, the Agent is expressed as acting with respect to a Salient_entity associated with the task. In most cases the Salient_entity is located at the Post.

ex.t: Volunteers were staffing the telephones.
Man your stations! CNI

fes.d: The Agent is assigned to a Post to perform a task involving a Salient_entity.
This FE identifies the place where the Agent staffs the Post.
This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent works at the Post.
This FE identifies the time when the Agent works at the Post.
This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent works at the Post.

Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).
The Frequency with which the Agent works in a given period of time.
The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.
The Result of working at the Post.
Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the state of affairs expressed by the target, but not in all cases.
This FE gives a description of the working event.
The Post is a location or station assigned to the Agent where a task or tasks are to be performed.
The Salient_entity is centrally involved in the task the Agent is assigned to perform. It is normally located at the Post.
